name: Úrkút (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner with a light grey triangle descending from the top edge to a point near the bottom over a red field, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Úrkút (a white and red shield with a chalice, an oak bough and crossed hammers) below a scroll inscribed ÚRKÚT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: inverted triangle from the top edge
